mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with unemployment below 4.5%, labor market tightness drives wage inflation and forces monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market under monetary tightening, suppressing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
